The '''Sinking City''' was the name given to the region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] located north of the [[Brell Sediment]]. It was so named for its eastern region, where the [[Sliding plate|the ground had begun to sink]] around the ruins of the [[Jedi Tower]].
